longDescription: Make a post in Kimi and Welder puts it on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook Pages, Threads, Bluesky and X, now or at a time you choose. You see every post before it goes live. Sign in to Welder and connect your own accounts; provider consent happens in your browser.
tryPrompts: Post this video to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube tomorrow at 9am
Show how my posts from the last 30 days performed and what to try next
Read the new comments on my latest post and draft replies for me to review

welder.description: Publishing, scheduling, analytics and comments for your connected social accounts

get-started.description: Connect social accounts and start your first workflow

publish-content.description: Post approved videos, photos, carousels and text

review-performance.description: Compare post results and plan what to try next
